validity.recommendation: No action needed on existence/classification/duplicate axes.
validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: strongly confirmed. Two independent Arabic-language articles (verified live via url_verifier) both describe this exact project by name, length, and cost: egyptoil-gas.com (2020-09-13, English) reports 'the new EGP 920 million 115 kilometers (km) Sokhna-El Tebbin pipeline project for the circulation of petroleum products' inspected by Min. Tarek El Molla; youm7.com (2021-12-19, Arabic, the sheet's own current ref) independently lists 'خط السخنة - التبين لنقل المنتجات البترولية بطول 115 كم وبتكلفة 920 مليون جنيه ... تم التشغيل' (Sokhna-Tebbin petroleum-products line, 115 km, EGP 920 million, commissioned). Two independent sources agreeing on name+length+cost to the exact figure is a high-tier existence confirmation, not a GEM-only entity. CLASSIFICATION: PipelineType='transmission' and Fuel='Oil products (only)' both confirmed - both sources describe a national-grid trunk artery moving petroleum products (not crude, not gas) from the Ain Sokhna port to the Tebbin hub near Cairo and onward to Upper Egypt for the first time; this is materially a transmission line, not a gathering/feeder line. DUPLICATE: checked against the full 46-row Egypt-oil roster. No other row shares this name or this Sokhna->Tebbin corridor. It is distinct from P7327 'Ain Sokhna-Al-Hafayer-Wadi hagool' (a separate diesel line, ~41-42 km, also named in the same youm7 article as a different project: 'خط نقل السولار السخنة/الحفاير/وادى حجول بطول 41 كم'). Not a duplicate of anything on the roster.

validity.recommendation: Verify actual commissioning year; possibly move StartYear1 from 2021 to 2020 or earlier. Also seek a working, non-blocked source for Diameter (24 in) and Capacity (8,000,000 tn/y) - the sheet's only ref for both is a Cloudflare-blocked ahram.org.eg page.
validity.researcher_notes: StartYear1=2021 is sourced only from the youm7 article's publish date (2021-12-19), which lists the line as already 'تم التشغيل' (commissioned) among a roundup of completed/in-progress projects - it does NOT state a commissioning date, so 2021 appears to be an inference from the article's publication date rather than an explicit start date. That inference looks too late: an independent egyptoil-gas.com article dated 2020-09-13 already describes the identical 115 km / EGP 920 million Sokhna-Tebbin line as an existing 'new ... pipeline project' that the Minister personally inspected - language consistent with a line that was already built (or substantially complete) more than a year before the youm7 piece. This is a genuine, material date disagreement, not a rounding difference: on current evidence the pipeline was very likely operating by September 2020, not 2021. Recommend Update leg re-derive StartYear1 from a source with an explicit commissioning date, or default to <=2020 pending that. SPEC gap on CAPACITY/DIAMETER: both fields cite only https://gate.ahram.org.eg/News//1893384.aspx, which returns a Cloudflare 'Just a moment...' challenge (HTTP 403) on every fetch attempt in this session (curl with multiple UAs, and WebFetch) - this is a BLOCK per standing rule, not proof the page or value is wrong, so I am not recommending deletion. But it also means neither figure has ever been independently corroborated. The one adjacent figure available, egyptoil-gas's 'equivalent to 20,000 tons per day' handling rate, annualizes to ~7.30-7.98 million tons/year depending on the day-count convention used (365 vs ~400), which sits close to but not identical to the sheet's 8,000,000 tn/y - plausibly the same figure loosely rounded in translation, but not an exact independent match, so I am treating Capacity as medium-tier (single real source, one loosely-consistent secondary figure) rather than high. Diameter (24 in) has zero independent corroboration at all currently.

summary: P7321 (Ain Sokhna-El-Tibeen, 115km/24in, operating): existence, classification, and non-duplicate status all confirmed (caveat, high tier) via two independent sources exactly matching name/length/cost; concern flagged (spec) - StartYear1=2021 looks too late against a Sept-2020 source describing the line as already built, and Diameter/Capacity rest solely on a Cloudflare-blocked ahram.org.eg page with no independent corroboration. No fills; nothing UNRESOLVED beyond the flagged StartYear/Diameter/Capacity gaps.
